notes.title: Patch #3 - Mostly fixing small issues
notes.content:
[u]Bigger changes[/u]
- Front drill is now at 90 degrees. It actually does make quite a difference.
- Repair bar now disappears when entering the submarine if you enter with left click or right trigger held down.

[u]Bug fixes[/u]
- In the new controls option, I've stopped the torpedo and harpoon flashing when clicking certain directions.
- Slightly reduced bigger explosion sizes.
- When Syringe and Attack drone is unlocked, pressing the syringe icon when out the submarine no longer releases the drone.
- Restored the ability to preview other submarine types, as well as getting rid of needing e.g survivall sub unlocked to be able to select an unlocked attack one- something that came from another patch.
- Exp is now not resetting when out of oxygen + loot drone returning. A rare situation but not one we want to happen.

notes.title: Update- New Control Options
notes.content:
Addressing comments about the realistic controls, some players were finding them difficult to master. As a result, for keyboard users, you can now control the submarine with traditional 8 direction.

I don't recommend using these controls as it does take from the intended simulation aspect of the experience, but it is there in the pause menu if really needed.

Enjoy the game! And please review us! <3

notes.title: Patch #2- Small edits
notes.content:
A few changes:

- Divers can now access the emergency shop.
- Fixed turning animation for the sub breaking when the thing they're holding in the front claw blows up.
- Fixed tickbox from the pause menu appearing after loading a save.

Please continue to post your bugs in the forums.

And we need your reviews!

notes.title: Patch #1- Rare issues fixed
notes.content:
Thank you for your bug reports, here are the results of this patch:

- Removed the ability to change volume while the menu is not up via adjusting the sliders.

- The current no longer affects divers. This stops the submarines from ever getting stuck out of easy diver reach, forcing you to quick travel to the shop.

- Fixed two reported gamepad issues- firing harpoons under certain conditions, and the emergency shop acting like the shop ship causing problems with submarine type.

- As for the controls, I know it is a decisive part of the gameplay, but as some have pointed out it is what the game is. This is a game that if you casually put time into and you will know expertly the controls. So many modern games are too easy and offer no learning experience!


Changes to UIs etc should change upon loading last save. Any graphic changes will require a respawn or, changing area.

Thank you divers! Please don't forget to review the game! And report any issues in the discussions.
